rows.clinical_trial_responsible_party: Wyeth is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Pfizer
rows.outcome_overview_description: Antibody geometric mean titers as measured by OPA assays for the 12 common serotypes (serotypes 1, 3, 4, 5, 6B, 7F, 9V, 14, 18C, 19A, 19F, and 23F). Confidence intervals (CI) for the GMTs are back transformations of a CI based on the Student t distribution for the mean logarithm of the titers.
rows.outcome_overview_time_frame: 1 month after Vax 1 / Year 0, 1 month after Vax 2 / Year 1
